title.en:
The greet service,
built in ten chapters.
title.zh:
greet 服务，
分十章搭起来。

standfirst.en: Every chapter adds one capability to the same running service. By the last one it answers over HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC, keeps its rows in SQLite, and carries tests that go red when any of that stops being true.
standfirst.zh: 每章给同一个在跑的服务加一件事。到最后一章，它同时通过 HTTP、GraphQL 和 gRPC 回答，把行存进 SQLite，并带着测试：其中任何一处失效，测试就会红。

note.en: `x-request-id` is the middleware from chapter 1. `server: mooncat` is the transport signing its own work. The body is a row moonsqlite returned and moonorm decoded, on a connection the process opened at boot.
note.zh: `x-request-id` 是第 1 章那个中间件加的。`server: mooncat` 是传输层写下的名字。正文是 moonsqlite 返回、moonorm 解码出来的一行，走的是进程启动时打开的那条连接。

layersHint.en: in the order the request meets them

layersLead.en: Each line is one library doing one thing to the same request, and any of them can be swapped without the others noticing. The numbers match the transcript in chapter 8.
layersLead.zh: 每一行是一个库对同一个请求做的一件事，换掉其中任何一个，别的都不必改。编号与第 8 章那份回放对得上。

did.en: Reads the `.api` spec into routes and types.
did.zh: 把 `.api` 描述读成路由与类型。

did.en: Carries the request value every layer passes around.
did.zh: 传那个各层共用的请求值。

did.en: Wraps the routes in a service and logs the call.
did.zh: 把路由装进服务，并记下这次调用。

did.en: Matches the path, binds `id`, builds the body.
did.zh: 匹配路径、绑定 `id`、拼出响应体。

did.en: Builds the statement and decodes the row it gets back.
did.zh: 拼出语句，并把回来的行解码。

did.en: Writes the bytes to the socket.
did.zh: 把字节写到 socket 上。

did.en: Answers the same data as a GraphQL field on the same app.
did.zh: 在同一个应用上把同样的数据作为 GraphQL 字段回答。

did.en: Serves the same greeting over HTTP/2 cleartext.
did.zh: 把同一句问候通过 h2c 提供出去。

did.en: Asks a model through a template and a provider.
did.zh: 通过模板与提供者去问一个模型。

colophon.en: every output on these pages comes from a real run
colophon.zh: 本站每个输出都来自真实运行

lineage.en: `moonhelo` is moon and `helo`, which is hello with the last two letters off. The example inside is go-zero's `greet`, which is why the spec still says `service greet`.
lineage.zh: `moonhelo` 是 moon 加 `helo`，也就是把 hello 的后两个字母去掉。里面的示例沿用 go-zero 的 `greet`，所以 spec 里仍然写着 `service greet`。
